Review a notes directory such as `~/Documents/Notes`.

Glob for `~/Documents/Notes/*.md` and read up to five files. If the directory does not exist, say so and stop. Identify unfinished tasks, repeated reminders, and anything that looks time-sensitive. Check `state.md` for open follow-ups from prior runs and address or update them if resolved.

Write a prioritized action list to `~/Documents/Notes/next-actions.md`. Do not modify the original note files.
